issue: actor-koro / koro-search sinks 0.169 m below the ground plane (tests/rendering/story-map-assets.test.mjs, grove.json manifest)

asset.pipelineProof: A control re-bake of the unmodified authoring code reproduced asset-source/animation/companions-blender/koro.json byte-for-byte (sha256 03351f5de9d504b99779aba19705ea882b5c7ba810f15f47db54e17623218675), so the shipped koro-search is the Blender-authored clip. The author-creature-clips.mjs koro-search in actor-koro-combat.glb is the superseded one (it was replaced by the companion merge and sinks 0.0456 m).

diagnosis.measuredWith: real GLTFLoader sampling with LoopOnce + clampWhenFinished, every native key time, 12 uniform samples per clip and the true terminal frame (the same sampler the failing gate uses), plus the evaluated skinned mesh inside Blender
diagnosis.cause: koro_search aims the right arm's IK chain at a ground contact height of 0.035, but the chain's last joint is the R_Hand wrist, whose own skinned geometry (the fingers) hangs 0.15553 below that joint in the rest pose. The aim point was therefore a finger-contact height applied to a wrist joint, so the fingertips were driven 0.119 m below the ground at the deepest frame.
ruledOut: the crouch itself: the crouch's own hip drop (0.12) and torso pitch (42 deg) only account for the Waist vertex at 0.0355 m sink, which is inside the 0.15 m tolerance
the body/leg pose: the feet and toes stay on the ground (R_Foot joint height constant at 0.02112 m for the whole clip) and the left hand never goes below the ground
an actor-lift or scale problem: the manifest's 1.422 scale is applied by the test itself and the other eleven clips of the same asset all pass
the renderer: the penetration is already present in the authored keyframes and is reproducible offline in Blender without the renderer

fix.change: koro_search's right-hand reach now aims the wrist so the FINGERTIPS meet the authored ground contact height, instead of aiming the wrist joint at it. The wrist aim height is solved per frame (koro_reach_to_ground): the real, deformed fingertips are measured on the evaluated skinned mesh and the aim is corrected by the residual until the fingertips land on the intended height. The helper measurements (koro_hand_vertices, koro_hand_lowest, koro_hand_drop) read the imported skinned mesh, not the rig's joint offsets.
fix.whyNotAConstantOffset: A constant rest-pose offset was measured and rejected: the hand's effective vertical drop changes as the arm rotates, so a constant offset left the fingertips hovering 0.048-0.14 m above the ground. The per-frame solve lands them on the authored 0.035 contact height.
fix.alsoFixed: The shipped reach over-extended the arm to a locked straight elbow (0 deg, shoulder-to-wrist pinned at the full 0.39968 arm length) because the aim point was out of reach. The corrected aim keeps the elbow bent (68-93 deg through the inspect hold) and the reach inside the arm length.
notDone: no constant actor lift, no mesh shrink, no renderer change, no tolerance change, no change to the shared authoring helpers
